title: inspectFile
body:
## inspectFile

Inventory an existing HDF5 file - groups, datasets, types, shapes, layouts, filters, fill values, attributes, links, hard-link aliases, dimension scales, virtual and external storage - and decide typed expectations such as units, shapes, ranges, finiteness and compression as met or unmet.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Read-only: the captured copy is read by h5py and h5dump, which must agree before anything is reported.
- Expectations are decided by the host from observed values, never by the native process.

Native binding: `h5py.File(r) visititems_links / Dataset.dtype, shape, maxshape, chunks, filters, fillvalue, external, virtual_sources / attrs / dims / h5r dereference`. Output kind: `["text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | Absolute path of the existing HDF5 file to read; it is captured and never modified. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | **required** |
| `sha256` | Optional expected SHA-256 of the source; a mismatch refuses the run. | `{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64}` | omitted |
| `dependencies` | Other files the result uses or reads, captured and published with it. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096,"required":true},"sha256":{"type":"string","minLength":64,"maxLength":64},"role":{"type":"enum","values":["virtualSource","externalLink","rawStorage","copySource","reference"],"required":true},"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64}}},"maxItems":64}` | `[]` |
| `expectations` | Typed requirements decided as met or unmet. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":40,"required":true},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":1024,"required":true},"present":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["group","dataset","datatype","softLink","externalLink"]},"class":{"type":"enum","values":["float","int","uint","complex","bool","string","enum","compound","vlen","reference","opaque"]},"bits":{"type":"enum","values":[8,16,32,64,128]},"shape":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2147483648},"maxItems":8},"units":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64},"attribute":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":255},"value":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"string","maxLength":65535},{"type":"boolean"},{"type":"array","items":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"string","maxLength":65535},{"type":"boolean"},{"type":"array","maxItems":65536,"items":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"string","maxLength":65535},{"type":"boolean"},{"type":"array","maxItems":65536,"items":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"string","maxLength":65535},{"type":"boolean"}]}}]}}]},"maxItems":65536}]},"minimum":{"type":"number"},"maximum":{"type":"number"},"finite":{"type":"boolean"},"compression":{"type":"enum","values":["none","gzip","lzf","szip"]},"minCompressionRatio":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":1000000},"maxAllocatedBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":1125899906842624}}},"maxItems":256}` | `[]` |
| `preview` | Maximum values shown per dataset or attribute in the inventory. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":256}` | `8` |
| `access` | Optional access tuning for this run (chunk cache, alignment, metadata block, page buffer, extraction memory budget). | `{"type":"object","properties":{"chunkCache":{"type":"object","properties":{"bytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":1073741824,"required":true},"slots":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":16777213,"default":12421},"preemption":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1,"default":0.75}}},"pageBufferBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":512,"maximum":1073741824},"metaBlockBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":512,"maximum":16777216},"alignment":{"type":"object","properties":{"threshold":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":2147483648,"default":1},"interval":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":16777216,"required":true}}},"memoryBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":4096,"maximum":1073741824},"sieveBufferBytes":{"type":"integer","minimum":512,"maximum":268435456}}}` | omitted |
